steps.title: Identify CRISPR target sites
steps.instruction: Use the flyCRISPR target finder (https://flycrispr.org/target-finder/) to locate 20‑nt sequences adjacent to a 3‑nt NGG PAM within the genomic region of interest; select a target with a 5′ G for U6 transcription or add a 5′ G during oligo design; choose high stringency and the “NGG PAM sites only” option.

steps.title: Design and order gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Select “design experiment” to obtain two oligonucleotides containing CTTC 5′ overhang and CAAA 3′ overhang; order them phosphorylated at the 5′ end or phosphorylate later with T4 polynucleotide kinase.

steps.title: Identify flanking CRISPR targets
steps.instruction: For two‑step CRISPR, locate one target on each side of the region using the same flyCRISPR workflow; if no hits, lower stringency or choose alternative sites; verify that no SNPs are present in the target or PAM by sequencing the stock genome.

steps.title: Design homology arms and primers
steps.instruction: Design ~1 kb 5′ and 3′ homology arms (HAs) directly adjacent to each cleavage site; add restriction‑enzyme sites (absent from the HA) to primer 5′ ends; mutate the PAM only if the donor plasmid would retain the full guide sequence (not required for the one‑gRNA approach).

steps.title: Design reintegration primers
steps.instruction: Design primers to amplify the genomic region removed in step 1, adding EcoRI to the forward primer and NotI to the reverse primer (or alternative sites if those are present in the fragment); order the primers.

steps.title: Anneal gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Set up a 10 µL annealing reaction per oligo pair: 1 µL forward (100 µM), 1 µL reverse (100 µM), 1 µL 10× ligation buffer, 7 µL nuclease‑free water; thermocycle at 95 °C for 5 min then ramp to 25 °C at –0.1 °C/s.

steps.title: Digest and dephosphorylate vector
steps.instruction: In a 40 µL reaction digest 1 µg pU6‑BbsI‑gRNA plasmid with 10 Units BbsI‑HF (NEB) for 2 h at 37 °C; add Calf Intestinal Alkaline Phosphatase (NEB, Cat# M0290) and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Gel purify digested vector
steps.instruction: Run the digest on a 1 % agarose gel at 100 V for ~30 min; excise the linearized band and purify using a QIAquick PCR & Gel Cleanup Kit (Qiagen, Cat# 28506).

steps.title: Ligate and transform
steps.instruction: Ligate the annealed oligos into the linearized vector with T4 DNA ligase (NEB, Cat# M0202); transform the ligation into Stellar competent cells (TaKaRa, Cat# 636763).

steps.title: Verify gRNA insertion
steps.instruction: Day 2: pick colonies and inoculate 14 h liquid cultures; Day 3: perform a miniprep with PureLink Quick Plasmid Miniprep Kit (Thermo Fisher, Cat# K210010); send DNA for sequencing with T7 or T3 primers; Day 5: confirm insertion from sequencing results; keep cultures overnight for further use.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid DNA for injection
steps.instruction: Perform a maxi‑prep of the verified plasmid using the Maxi Prep Plus Kit (Qiagen, Cat# 12963); elute in nuclease‑free water (Thermo Fisher, Cat# AM9938), include the extra wash step, filter the eluate with Millipore filters (Merck, Cat# SLGVR04NL), and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Amplify HA1 and HA2
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify HA1 (5′) and HA2 (3′) from genomic DNA using a high‑fidelity polymerase (Q5, NEB, Cat# M0491 or Phusion, Thermo Fisher, Cat# F530); digest the purified PCR products with the restriction enzymes whose sites were added to the HA primers.

steps.title: Insert HA1 into donor backbone
steps.instruction: Digest the donor plasmid pBS‑24xMS2‑loxP‑DsRed‑loxP (pDsRed‑24MS2) with the same enzymes as HA1; dephosphorylate with CIP (NEB, Cat# M0290); gel‑purify the linearized vector; ligate HA1 insert with T4 DNA ligase; transform into competent cells.

steps.title: Verify HA1 insertion
steps.instruction: Day 2: pick colonies and grow 14 h cultures; Day 3: miniprep and perform diagnostic restriction digests (using the same enzymes as for HA1 insertion); run digests on agarose gel; sequence using primers flanking the insert; Day 5: confirm correct HA1 insertion.

steps.title: Insert HA2 into HA1‑containing plasmid
steps.instruction: Repeat the amplification, digestion, ligation and transformation steps used for HA1, this time with HA2 and the pDsRed‑24MS2+HA1 plasmid.

steps.title: Verify HA2 and generate final donor
steps.instruction: Perform diagnostic digests and sequencing as for HA1 (Days 2‑5); once HA2 is confirmed, prepare a high‑quality maxiprep of the final pDsRed‑24MS2+HA1+HA2 plasmid (Qiagen Maxi Prep Plus Kit, Cat# 12963) for microinjection.

steps.title: Alternative attP cloning workflow
steps.instruction: Amplify HA1 and HA2 as above; insert HA1 into linearized pTVCherry vector; verify HA1 insertion; ligate HA2 into pTVCherry+HA1; verify HA2; generate a maxiprep of pTVCherry+HA1+HA2; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Microinject plasmids into embryos
steps.instruction: Inject the donor plasmid together with one (one‑step) or two (two‑step) gRNA plasmids into Cas9‑expressing embryos (e.g., yw, nos‑Cas9); use 100 ng/µL of each gRNA plasmid and 500 ng/µL of the donor plasmid; inject 200–400 embryos per batch.

steps.title: One‑step CRISPR crossing scheme
steps.instruction: Week 3: cross each F0 survivor to a 2nd‑chromosome balancer (y1 w67c23; snaSco/CyO); Week 5: screen F1 for DsRed fluorescence (3×P3 promoter); Week 5: cross DsRed‑positive F1 individually to a Cre‑recombinase line (e.g., P[w+, Cre] on CyO); verify loss of DsRed and correct integration by PCR and sequencing; Week 7: select flies that have lost DsRed but retain CyO, cross them to generate a homozygous stock; Week 8: maintain homozygous flies for experiments. Store plasmids at –20 °C.

steps.title: Two‑step CRISPR crossing scheme
steps.instruction: Week 3: cross each F0 survivor to a white‑fly stock (y1 w67c23 males); Week 5: identify F1 flies with red eyes (mini‑white marker); cross each positive to a 2nd‑chromosome balancer (y1 w67c23; snaSco/CyO); verify integration by PCR and sequencing; Week 7: select w+ CyO flies and cross to obtain a homozygous attP insertion (or maintain balanced stock if lethal); Weeks 9‑11: expand homozygous (or balanced) flies for a second round of microinjection of the reintegration plasmid.

steps.title: Reintegrate removed genomic region
steps.instruction: Linearize the RIVcherry+24xMS2‑stem‑loop plasmid with EcoRI and NotI; PCR‑amplify the previously deleted genomic fragment with matching EcoRI (forward) and NotI (reverse) sites; digest both vector and insert, ligate, gel‑purify the ligation product, and prepare a high‑quality plasmid prep for microinjection.
